      "observations": [
        "All 54 owned diff lines and both affected test task bodies were read. The first picker init changes from the main window to msgc.browsingContext. The second changes to msgc2.browsingContext and adds await SimpleTest.promiseFocus(msgc2) after the msgLoaded wait, before the save key targeted at msgc2.",
        "These are message windows, not compose windows. The secondary historical helper explicitly requests mail:messageWindow; the actual accepted open_message_from_file helper opens chrome://messenger/content/messageWindow.xhtml. Message loading, focus and the mock init argument are separate source facts.",
        "The older provisional lesson dcb7a7ef7aedd9a34aa25ed706e58ec7abcdebba540811c0aa9687a604dbb6dd says more than one compose window and states a universal per-window requirement. The additive replacement narrows it to this owned test phase and retracts that role/requirement interpretation while preserving the old record.",
        "Accepted source later initializes one MockFilePicker in add_setup, registers its cleanup and uses direct cmd_saveAsFile commands plus actual output checks. The second task retains a focus wait and adds root focus/a tick. That later source is not a new universal mock rule or an executed interception result.",
        "The historical file1 default-filename Assert.equal has no message; the historical file2 label is nonempty. Both selected accepted default-filename Assert.equal calls omit an expected-behavior message. This is a scoped assertion-message finding, separate from missing should alone.",
        "No mock API internals, native file dialog, OS focus race, file write or test was executed. Historical commit explanations are not independent failure reproduction. Unrelated helper lines accidentally emitted from a wrong numeric range are excluded from evidence; the correct message-window excerpt is retained.",
        "After reading the actual author reply, the exact original helper tail409–420 was checked: it awaits MsgLoaded/display completion, conditionally waits for window activation, waits one tick, then returns the message window. This supports the rejected extra file1 focus wait as a scoped helper contract; it does not establish a universal focus or mock ownership rule.",
        "Required full original Bug 1999601 current human timeline 0–38 with exact automated-comment exclusions and footer was read from the earlier A capture 643d846de8a6d2f9a0418cfe73211f84e598587b8685f605665100e346391dd6. This is pointer reuse of the same current capture, not a new browser confirmation. Complete D286557 timeline and both actual bodies were read from C3's original.",
        "The family history distinguishes the initial fix, continued/vsync failures, timeout increase, this focus/mock-context patch, later CCov timeout increase and another save attempt. Later failure reports prevent a claim that this owned patch proved a final cure. Linked logs/patch bodies remain unread dependencies.",
        "The bot requests both a context change and an extra focus wait for file1. The author accepts only the context correction, saying open_message_from_file already handles focus. A bounded new check of the exact original helper tail confirms message/display waits, conditional activation, a tick and return. File2 adds explicit promiseFocus; no universal duplicate-focus rule or native-picker ownership guarantee is inferred.",
        "Parent reviewed and approved the narrow additive replacement of provisional dcb7a7ef7aedd9a34aa25ed706e58ec7abcdebba540811c0aa9687a604dbb6dd: actual message-window role and historical arguments versus later setup-level mock are preserved with supersedes and source.replaces. The original evidence remains immutable. Deliberate guidance is unchanged.",
        "Author causal explanations, bot predicted latent failure, approval and historical build events remain private reports checked against source adoption; no shortcut, file save, focus race, mock interception or test ran."
      ],
